title: Microsoft exits 50 MW Nscale AI data center in Essex over UK grid delays
summary: Microsoft, the anchor tenant, pulled out of a 50 MW (scalable to 90 MW, 23,040 Nvidia GB300) Nscale site in Loughton after grid connection delays pushed power into the 2030s. Microsoft said the decision concerns a single site.
reason: A confirmed cancellation shows power limits slowing compute build-out, but it is one site, so a small F1 drag.
